title: Daande ummoraade e Buubi Ɓuuɓɗi
intro: Udditde sifaa neɗɗo luggiɗiiɗo mo yahdu mum fuɗɗii ko e kawral kaawis, mo darnde mum jokkondiri e rimɗinde leñol doolnungol. Oo neɗɗo suɓaama ngam gollal mawngal, jokkondirngal e caɗeele mawɗe e ballal Alla.
clues: Mi jibinaa ko e yonta tooñannge mawnge, ɗo cukalon leñol am mbaraa.
Nguurndam am gadano ko jibinannde am waɗti mi e maayo, tee mi tawaama, mi mawni ko e galle tooñoowo leñol am oo tigi.
Mi meeɗii dogde wuro caggal nde mi anniyaaki, mi waɗii maayde neɗɗo gooto e nder luural.
Mi heɓi nelal Alla e sawru kaawis to nokku ceniɗo, ɗo mi yamiraa yo mi fotndu laamɗo baawɗo.
Miñi am toɗɗaama ngam wonde balloowo am e golle am, sabu caɗeele ɗe nganndu-mi e haala am.
Mi ardii leñol am e nder maayo ceertungo, mi daɗii e dogde konu doolnuɗo.

trial.answer: Haɓde e Firawna e siñooɓe mum

outcome.answer: Firaawna e konu mum nduttiima e nder ndiyam

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
